clusterId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the cluster that contains the checkpoint.

completed.description: Date and time when the checkpoint completed and the balancer restarted. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project that owns the checkpoints.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies checkpoint.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

parts.description:
Metadata that describes the complete snapshot.

- For a replica set, this array contains a single document.
- For a sharded cluster, this array contains one document for each shard plus one document for the config host.

restorable.description: Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud can use the checkpoint for a restore.

started.description: Date and time when the balancer stopped and began the checkpoint. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

timestamp.description: Date and time to which the checkpoint restores. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

ApiBSONTimestampView.description: BSON timestamp that indicates when the checkpoint token entry in the oplog occurred.

date.description: Date and time when the oplog recorded this database operation. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

increment.description: Order of the database operation that the oplog recorded at specific date and time.

ApiBSONTimestampView.title: BSON Timestamp

ApiCheckpointPartView.description: Metadata contained in one document that describes the complete snapshot taken for this node.

replicaSetName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the replica set to which this checkpoint applies.

shardName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the shard to which this checkpoint applies.

tokenDiscovered.description: Flag that indicates whether the token exists.

typeName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the type of host that the part represents.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.
